purpose: Research-only simulator limits. Not Desk Rules v0.2 and not the Stage 2 Gate 1 policy. These numbers are not the operational GBP 2.50 per-trade ceiling or the GBP 5.00 daily-loss ceiling. They do not authorise execution.

account.note: Illustration assumption only. Not the operational simulated desk account of GBP 500.00.

notes: One-way turnover is 0.5 * sum of absolute instrument-weight changes. Cash is the residual and is not double-counted. Moving from cash to 100% in one instrument is 0.50. Swapping one fully invested instrument for another is 1.00 and would be scaled.
The 0.50 single-instrument cap also applies to XSTR. A 100% cash-proxy ETF position is clipped. Literal cash can still be 100%.
The 0.20 commodity cap applies to SGLN. It is a placeholder, not an approved allocation.
